authors: Claude Code session (holant lead, step b)

links.note: Sizes reduced from the memo's 2^14, 2^16 to decisive 2^12-2^14 plus a descriptive 2^16, because one Q evaluation costs about 400 s at 2^16 here.

question: Does the small-x factor base, in discrete-log order, correlate with a quadratic phase e((alpha l^2 + beta l)/N) more than negation-closed random sets of the same size do?

claims.text: Q_EC lies inside its negation-closed null's 5-95% band on at least 8 of 9 decisive curves (NULL), or exceeds the null maximum on 2 of 3 curves at 2 of 3 sizes (SIGNAL), by the preregistered rule.
claims.if_supported: NULL: degree-2 phase leakage of the small-x predicate closed at toy scale beside H-PSEUDO
claims.if_not_supported: SIGNAL goes to review-breakthrough as the first non-linear Fourier bias on record

hypotheses.statement: No quadratic-phase correlation beyond the negation-closed null.
hypotheses.mechanism: x-coordinates are pseudo-random in log order beyond linear phases as well

predictions.minimum_effect: u in [0.05, 0.95] on >= 8 of 9 decisive curves

arms.description: logs of the first 512 points sorted by (x,y)

positive.expected_detection: Q >= 3 x the null max with argmax alpha = alpha0 or N - alpha0, every curve

null_population.generator: 256 distinct l in [1,(N-1)/2] by default_rng(derive_seed(sha,'N_sym',instance,draw)), set {l, N-l}
null_population.why_n: min attainable two-sided p 2/41 < 0.05; 9 decisive curves

factors.name: curve
factors.how: prime order != p, distinct orders, derive_seed(sha,'curve',L,0)

randomization.arm_order_reason: deterministic FFT values; order cannot change them

seed_derivation.note: derive_seed(protocol_sha, arm, instance, replicate) from tools/experiment_protocol.py

instance_sampling.rule: curves drawn before any Q is computed

blinding.how: frozen script applies a fixed rule

power.note: decision is a conjunctive count rule over 9 curves, not a per-curve test; a SIGNAL needs Q above all 40 draws on 2 of 3 curves at 2 sizes (null probability ~1e-4)

preflight_runtime.measured_on: this container: Q at N=4093 0.9 s, 16381 22 s, 65521 395 s (contended)

primary.name: within-null percentile of Q_EC
primary.definition: mid-rank percentile of Q_EC among the curve's N_sym draws

secondary.name: quadratic-phase maximum
secondary.definition: max over alpha, beta of |sum e((alpha l^2+beta l)/N)| / sqrt(|S|)

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: 10 curves x (1 EC + 40 or 5 nulls + 1 planted), then stop

decision_rule.text: Validity: planted Q >= 3x null max with argmax alpha in {alpha0, N - alpha0} on every curve; A/A even/odd null means within 3% per decisive size; else INVALID_CONTROLS. SIGNAL iff Q_EC exceeds the null max on >= 2 of 3 curves at >= 2 of the 3 decisive sizes. NULL iff Q_EC's percentile is in [0.05, 0.95] on >= 8 of 9 decisive curves. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. L = 16 is descriptive.

inadmissible: changing sizes, curves, draws or the rule after seeing Q
reading a SIGNAL as an attack cost before the sparse-Fourier recovery step is costed
